APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)

findings.why: Homogenisation of the BR-220 billet would move to a toll processor, Termica Nord S.r.l. The stated spec is "Same 6082-T6", but no certificate or test result is in the documents for billet that Termica Nord has processed. AP-0311 approves Alluminio B (Settimo Torinese) and does not mention Termica Nord. A person must supply the certificate or test evidence. The email EML-SQ-2026-1105 gives 6061-T6 for BR-220. That conflicts with AP-0311 (6082-T6, drawing Rev C) and is not controlled evidence.
